passage:
In science class, students learned that old satellites and broken parts can remain in orbit around Earth. This space junk may hit working satellites.
The class was surprised. They had imagined space as endless and empty.
The teacher explained that useful orbits are limited, and objects moving very fast can cause serious damage.
Students designed posters about cleaning space and building satellites that can safely return or move away after use.
The lesson changed their view of exploration. Reaching space is not only about going higher. It is also about taking responsibility for what humans leave behind.
Even above Earth, trash matters.
